string.name: subject
string.value: Sera's Mirror

string.name: desc
string.value: I ran into Heena who was worrying about her face getting irritated by the strong sunlight. I have to get a mirror for Heena from her sister, Sera.

string.name: desc
string.value: I borrowed a mirror from Sera who was doing her laundry. I have to take this mirror to Heena.

string.name: desc
string.value: I borrowed a mirror from Sera, who was doing her laundry, and brought it back to Heena.

string.name: subject
string.value: Roger's Apple

string.name: desc
string.value: By pressing the hotkey I, I can consume the #bapple#k in consumption window. Let's talk to #bRoger#k...

string.name: desc
string.value: I learned how to use items! This will make life much easier!

string.name: subject
string.value: Nina and Sen's Dinner Menu

string.name: desc
string.value: I ran into Nina who was thinking about what to make for Dinner for her brother, Sen. I have to go and talk to Sen who is in the house, and find out what he wants to have for dinner.

string.name: desc
string.value: I asked Sen, Nina's brother, what he wants to have for dinner. He answers he wants to have a#b Mushroom Soup#k. Let's get back to Nina now.

string.name: desc
string.value: I told Nina what Sen wants for dinner.

string.name: subject
string.value: Todd's How-to-Hunt

string.name: desc
string.value: Todd taught me to move towards upper right-hand side to attack and kill #bJr. Stoneball#k, take the item it drops, and talk to Peter...\n\nJr. Stoneballs to kill : #r#a00000051##k

string.name: desc
string.value: I killed the #bJr. Stoneball#k just as Todd taught me. Now I just have to take the #bpiece of rock#k to Peter...\n\nJr. Stoneballs to kill : #b#a00000051##k

string.name: desc
string.value: I killed the monster just as Todd told me.

string.name: subject
string.value: Letter for Lucas

string.name: desc
string.value: I met Maria who was desperately looking for help. She gave me a letter and asked me to bring this to Lucas in Amherst...

string.name: desc
string.value: I delivered Maria's letter to Lucas who was in Amherst. He wrote a reply, which I think I should bring back to Maria.

string.name: desc
string.value: Maria looked relieved after reading the reply from Lucas. I wanted to read it too, but I think I did what I was supposed to do.

string.name: subject
string.value: The Art of Enchantment

string.name: desc
string.value: I met #bSol#k at A Split Road and he told me about #bscroll enchantment#k. If I bring him #b15 snail shells#k and #b10 mushroom spores#k, along with the #bblank scroll#k, he can create a scroll for me!

string.name: desc
string.value: I brought all the ingredients Sol asked for and he made me a #bScroll for Defense#k. I should look for other scroll enchanters during my travels.

string.name: subject
string.value: Bigg's Collection of Items

string.name: desc
string.value: I met this crewmember named Biggs at Southperry. He asked me if I can get him #b10 orange mushroom tops and 30 blue snail shells#k and that he'll reward me with a nice item if I do so. He doesn't look too convinced that I can do this, but... it looks like a piece of cake to me.

string.name: desc
string.value: I got Biggs from Southperry #b10 mushroom tops and 30 blue snail shells#k. How is he going to do business out of this anyway? Well, he did get me a decent weapon to use. I guess I can travel for a while with this...

string.name: subject
string.value: Collecting Cards with Rin

string.name: desc
string.value: I met Rin in The Field West of Amherst and she told me about her collection of #bmonster cards#k. If I hunt the snails around here, maybe I can find one and start a collection of my own.

string.name: desc
string.value: I found a monster card from a Snail. I should go back to Rin and show her.

string.name: desc
string.value: Rin said I was a natural at collecting cards. She gave me one of her favorite cards as a reward and told me if I keep it up, I could have an even bigger collection than her someday.

string.name: subject
string.value: Pio's Collecting Recycled Goods

string.name: desc
string.value: I ran into Pio who is famous in Amherst for fixing broken goods. Pio tells me to break down scrap boxes from here and there in the village and bring back 10 #t4031161# and 10 #t4031162#. I think I saw some scrap boxes in the village...

string.name: desc
string.value: As Pio asked me, I broke down some useless boxes that were lying here and there in the village, and returned it to him. It was fun collecting them because I could find some useful stuff in them as well.

string.name: subject
string.value: Pio and the Recycling

string.name: desc
string.value: I helped Pio gather up the recycling materials, and he made a nice comfortable chair.

string.name: subject
string.value: Rain's Maple Quiz

string.name: desc
string.value: I'm not a MapleStory Beginner. Let's solve Rain's Quiz.

string.name: desc
string.value: Rain's First Quiz was, what is the hot-key to open the Item Inventory? I'll make sure I remember the hot-key "I"...

string.name: desc
string.value: I found out from Rain's Quiz that the wearable items can be equipped by double-clicking on the item.

string.name: desc
string.value: I found out "E" is the hot-key for opening the Equipment Window. I can take off what I'm wearing by double-clicking on the item in the Equipment Window.

string.name: desc
string.value: Rain's 4th Quiz was finding the hot-key for picking up the items on the ground. That's easy~ it's " Z" of course~ But I found out I can also pick up items with the number key "0"...

string.name: desc
string.value: Rain gave me a Quiz about Job Advancements. For Warriors, Thieves, and Bowmen, you need to be at least level 10, while for Magicians, you can advance at Level 8.

string.name: desc
string.value: I learned that every time my level goes up, I get 5 Ability Points(AP) that I can upgrade my abilities. I can see the detail with the hot-key "S".

string.name: desc
string.value: Rain advised me to leave Maple Island and go for a greater journey. In Victoria Island, you can choose your job, and face a whole lot of new adventures. Ok...let's go to Maple Island's Southperry...

string.name: subject
string.value: Mai's Training

string.name: desc
string.value:
I decided to get trained under the Famous Sword-Master, Mai, in Amherst. I guess hunting the weakest monsters is a good idea. Should I hunt Snail, Blue Snail, and Shroom in order? Mai told me to meet with #p20002# in Amherst and try training together...

Snails to kill : #r#a00004001##k
Blue Snails to kill : #r#a00004002##k
Shrooms to kill : #r#a00004003##k

string.name: desc
string.value:
I decided to get trained under the Famous Sword-Master, Mai, in Amherst. I guess hunting the weakest monsters is a good idea. It looks like I killed all of them~

Snails to kill : #b#a00004001##k
Blue Snails to kill : #b#a00004002##k
Shrooms to kill : #b#a00004003##k

string.name: desc
string.value: Mai trained me, and I feel I'm a lot stronger.

string.name: subject
string.value: Mai's Final Training

string.name: desc
string.value: Mai told me to hunt stronger monsters. Of course it is important to know your own strength, but to develop your strength, you need to try to hunt stronger monsters.\n\nOrange Mushrooms to kill : #r#a00004011##k

string.name: desc
string.value: Mai told me to hunt stronger monsters. Of course it is important to know your own strength, but to develop your strength, you need to try to hunt stronger monsters. I think I got them all!\n\nOrange Mushrooms to kill : #b#a00004011##k

string.name: desc
string.value: After getting Mai's traning, I became much stronger. I think I am going to leave Maple Island to get a job I like. Let's go to Southperry and head to Victoria Island.

string.name: subject
string.value: "Mar" the Fairy and the LifeWater

string.name: desc
string.value: At Ellinia, I ran into a fairy that's been busily studying the magic of life. Her name is "Mar" and after taking a look at my pet that's been turned into a doll, she told me she can make it come back alive with #bThe Water of Life#k and #bThe Scroll of Life#k. I heard that she knows Cloy of Henesys... since it looks like a pet trainer named #bTrainer Bartos#k of Henesys knows something about the scroll of life, I should head over there...

string.name: desc
string.value: After easily passing the test from Trainer Bartos of Henesys, I got a hold of #bThe Water of Life#k and #bThe Scroll of Life#k, and got that to "Mar" the fairy. With her magical power and the items I got her, she turned the doll back into a living pet. I can hang out with him for a while longer now ... sweet ...

string.name: subject
string.value: A Lesson on Job Advancement

string.name: desc
string.value: I'll have to listen to Olaf carefully as he describes the in's and out's of each and every job, because he'll quiz me on it afterwards.

string.name: desc
string.value: I answered all the questions Olaf asked. I'll have to be at least on#b level 10#k in order to become a#b warrior, thief, or a bowman#k, and#b level 8#k to become a #bmagician#k. Warrior-hopefuls will need to head over to Perion for job-advancement, Kerning City for thief-hopefuls, Ellinia for magician-hopefuls, and Henesys for bowman-hopefuls.

string.name: subject
string.value: The Path of Warrior

string.name: desc
string.value: Olaf of Lith Harbor tells me I can choose to become a #bwarrior#k if I'm at least on #blevel 10#k. He tells me I'll need to see #rSitting Bull#k of #rPerion#k ... but how do I get there? I'll have to check on the world map. (#rW#k)

string.name: desc
string.value: I have learned what it takes to become a true warrior through Sitting Bull. Hope this is the right path I'm taking...

string.name: subject
string.value: The Path of Bowman

string.name: desc
string.value: Olaf of Lith Harbor tells me I can choose to become a #bbowman#k if I'm at least on #blevel 10#k. He tells me I'll need to see #rHelena#k of #rHenesys#k ... but how do I get there? I'll have to check on the world map. (#rW#k)

string.name: desc
string.value: I have learned what it takes to become a true bowman through Helena of Henesys. Hope this is the right path I'm taking...

string.name: subject
string.value: The Path of Thief

string.name: desc
string.value: Olaf of Lith Harbor tells me I can choose to become a #bthief#k if I'm at least on #blevel 10#k. He tells me I'll need to see #rDark Road#k of #rKerning City#k ... but how do I get there? I'll have to check on the world map. \n(#rW#k)

string.name: desc
string.value: I have learned what it takes to become a true thief through Dark Road of Kerning City.

string.name: subject
string.value: The Path of Magician

string.name: desc
string.value: Olaf of Lith Harbor tells me I can choose to become a #bmagician#k if I'm at least on #blevel 8#k. He tells me I'll need to see #rHines#k of #rEllinia#k ... but how do I get there? I'll have to check on the world map. (#rW#k)

string.name: desc
string.value: I have learned what it takes to become a true magician through the chief of all wizards, Hines. Hope this is the right path I'm taking...

string.name: subject
string.value: Fixing "Blackbull's" House

string.name: desc
string.value: Right here, in this dusty town of Perion, I ran into an oddly-dressed man named "Blackbull." He told me he needs to fix is house and wondered if I could help him out by getting him #b30 tree branches and 50 firewoods#k. If I do him a favor, I get myself a nice shield that he has, but what if I say no? I wouldn't ... be ... EATEN BY HIM ... no?? I really hope not...

string.name: desc
string.value: I got "Blackbull" of Perion #b30 tree branches and 50 firewoods#k. With these, he can finally fix his house. I got this shield as a reward ... and ... well, scratchmarks here and there, and it looks pretty old ... is this even usable?

string.name: subject
string.value: I Need Help on My Homework!

string.name: req
string.value: Level 10

string.name: desc
string.value: Wing the Fairy of Ellinia seems to have a general disdain for humans. Definitely not the kind of attitude I expect from someone in need of help. He asked me if I can get him 30 tree branches, 30 squishy liquids, and 10 slime bubbles. He needs them so he can make a potion for his homework.

string.name: desc
string.value: I helped Wing the Fairy of Ellinia with his homework. I have no idea how that potion works, though.

string.name: subject
string.value: I'm Bored

string.name: req
string.value: Level 10

string.name: desc
string.value: I got to talk to Icarus of Kerning City. Just what exactly is he doing staring aimlessly at the sky anyway? He seemed to be really bored, and asked me if I can answer his set of questions.

string.name: desc
string.value: I answered all of Icarus's questions, but he still seemed bored out of his mind. He asked me if I could get him a toy that he could play around with. I'll bring him #b40 tree branches#k and #b40 squishy liquids#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: I had fun playing around with Icarus.

string.name: subject
string.value: The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies

string.name: req
string.value: Level 10

string.name: desc
string.value: I got to meet Bruce, who has been studying the monsters and animals in general in Henesys. His bright smile and the easy-going demeanor belies the painful fact that his daughter has been missing for some time, and that he's been studying the mushroom monsters for the sake of finding a clue on his daughter's whereabouts. He asks me if I can help him out by bringing #b10 mushroom spores#k and #b40 orange mushroom tops#k, and I just can't say no to a worthy cause like this...

string.name: desc
string.value: I helped Bruce gather up the materials necessary for his studies. Will these help him find his daughter?

string.name: subject
string.value: I Need to Find My Daughter

string.name: req
string.value: Level 10

string.name: desc
string.value: I met up with Bruce in Henesys, and he had great news: He finally found his daughter!!! There was one problem, however: She seems to be suffering from amnesia, Bruce gave me a toy that his daughter played around while growing up, and asked me if I can give that to her.

string.name: desc
string.value: Amazingly, Ayan recovered from amnesia with the help of the toy sword. That's just amazing!!! The only thing left now is for Ayan and Bruce to finally meet up, but first, I got to get this letter from Ayan to Bruce.

string.name: desc
string.value: I'm so glad that Ayan got her memory back. I'm even gladder that Bruce got to finally see his daughter again! What a moment...

string.name: subject
string.value: The Stump Horror Story

string.name: req
string.value: Level 10

string.name: desc
string.value: I met Ayan of Perion. Apparently, she cannot remember anything about her childhood, and she lives everyday in fear of Stumps. So scared, in fact, that she can't even dare to look at it. Accompanied by this paralyzing fear of Stumps, she cannot take one step out of Perion, and asks me to take out #b50 Stumps#k for her sake. Are they really THAT scary?\n\nStumps to kill : #r#a10057001##k

string.name: desc
string.value: I met Ayan of Perion. Apparently, she cannot remember anything about her childhood, and she lives everyday in fear of Stumps. So scared, in fact, that she can't even dare to look at it. Accompanied by this paralyzing fear of Stumps, she cannot take one step out of Perion, and asks me to take out #b50 Stumps#k for her sake. They weren't so scary!\n\nStumps to kill : #b#a10057001##k

string.name: desc
string.value: I took out Stumps for the sake of Ayan in Perion. She can finally venture outside without having to worry about them!

string.name: subject
string.value: Fanzy the Mysterious Cat

string.name: req
string.value: Level 10, Pet required

string.name: desc
string.value: I heard a really weird dream story from #bNella#k, who lived in Kerning City. She ran into a cat in the middle of a green forest full of trees... and she can't tell if it's a dream or for real.

string.name: desc
string.value: In the middle of the forest in Ellinia, I found the mysterious cat that Nella had seen in her dream. It introduced itself as Fanzy, and it's a cat that is raised by a fairy living in Ellinia Forest. A few days ago, while hanging out in the forest, it lost the #bred ball of yarn#k that's been given by its master. Fanzy really wanted me to find it for it, so in the middle of the forest, I better find #rSlime#k, fight to get the #bball of yarn#k back, then bring them back to Fanzy with my pet by my side for a handsome reward...

string.name: desc
string.value: I brought the red ball of yarn back from Slime to Fanzy, and to my delight, Fanzy increased the closeness level between my pet and me.

string.name: subject
string.value: Nella & Kerning City Citizen's Request 1

string.name: req
string.value: Level 15, Beginners not allowed

string.name: desc
string.value: I gave Nella 1000 mesos as a commission for hooking up Kerning City citizen's request. First request was to get the materials for Mapa, the owner of armor shop. The materials for making new armor are #b50 Green Mushroom tops#k and #b50 Bubbling's huge bubbles#k. It wouldn't be that hard, since I can easily find Green Mushrooms near the Ellina and Bubblings at the Subway.

string.name: desc
string.value: I gave what Mapa asked for and I got bunch of lemons for return. I wonder what kind of armor would Mapa make. Nella said there are many more requests I can do. I should visit Nella every once in a while.

string.name: desc
string.value: I got the second request from Nella. Shumi wants to make a house for her little puppy. To make a puppy house, she needs #b5 Processed Woods#k and #b5 Screws#k. I need to get those ASAP.

string.name: desc
string.value: I gave what Shumi asked for and I got bunch of cakes for return. Now, Shumi's little puppy has her own house~ I should get back to Nella for more requests.

string.name: desc
string.value: I got the third request from Nella. Andre in the hair shop wanted to eat Seafood Soup. I should get #b100 Octopus Legs#k and #bPure Water#k for his Seafood Soup ingredients.

string.name: desc
string.value: I gave what Andre asked for and I got the glove for return. I hope Andre can enjoy his Seafood Soup~ I should get back to Nella for more requests.

string.name: subject
string.value: Maya and the Weird Medicine

string.name: req
string.value: Level 15, Beginners not allowed

string.name: desc
string.value: I met this girl named Maya at the old, raggedy townstreet of Henesys. She's been suffering from illness for a long time, so she doesn't look too well to even live a normal life.#b Weird Medicine#k... what a strange name, and she said she'll get a little bit better by taking that... I better go to Lith Harbor and see this crewmember named Teo...

string.name: desc
string.value: Around "The Victoria" in Lith Harbor, I met this heavily-bearded crewmember called Teo. He said he has the #bWeird Medicine#k but he wasn't willing to give it up for free. Instead he said he'll trade with me for a #bglimmering stone#k. I mean, he does look like he knows Maya pretty well, but he still wants to make a deal with me, knowing how sick she is ...?? That's strange... anyway, to get that #bglimmering stone#k, I need to head over to Perion and talk to the #rSophia#k, the daughter of the owner of the grocery store there.

string.name: desc
string.value: I finally met Sophia, who's working on her dream as an alchemist inside the grocery store in Perion. To make the glimmering stone, she said she needs #b50 squishy liquid's, 50 leaves, 20 octopus legs and 1 Arcon's blood#k. Everything else looks reasonable enough except ... Arcon's blood ...??? Fortunately, Sophia knew where to get it. She told me to look for this man named Manji somewhere around Perion. Manji, huh ... where must he be ... ??

string.name: desc
string.value: I found Manji at Perion. Just as I thought, he was unwilling to give away #bArcon's blood#k for free. He wants me to go to the underground tunnel in the middle of the island and gather up #b40 charms of the dead#k for him ... by the way, who does he think he is, treating me like that?? I'm starting to regret saying yes to Maya in the first place ...

string.name: desc
string.value: I gathered up #b40 charms of the dead#k from the underground tunnel and got them to Manji of Perion. Still cocky, still arrogant, but following through his promise, he hands over #bArcon's blood#k to me. Hmm ... maybe he isn't so horrible a guy afterall ... anyway, now I need to gather up #b50 squishy liquid's, 50 leaves, 20 octopus legs, and 1 Arcon's blood#k for Sophia ...

string.name: desc
string.value: Sophia looks genuinely surprised that I gathered up every single material needed for the #bglimmering stone#k. Well, it wasn't easy at all ... anyway, she handed me the piece of #bglimmering stone#k made out of all the materials I got for her. Hmmm ... this #bglimmering stone#k ... it gives off a strange light, and then ... it starts glittering, and ... now I can understand why people want this...!! Well, now that I have it, all I got left is trading it with Teo in Lith Harbor.

string.name: desc
string.value: I traded the #bglimmering stone#k with Teo of Lith Harbor for the #bweird medicine#k. Now, all I need to do is get this to #rMaya#k, and I'm done...but...the more I think about it...the more I regret saying yes...anyway, this medicine...looks quite tasty... hmmm...if I get thirsty, should I just down this instead??

string.name: desc
string.value: I went back to Henesys and handed Maya the weird medicine. Hopefully she'll get better after taking this. As a sign of thanks, Maya got me 5,000 mesos and a #bbrown bamboo hat#k. This hat ... I mean, it looks like it's going to help when I'm walking under a blazing sun, but it looks so old and raggedy ... and if I put it on, it makes this weird noise that feels as if some insect is walking around and stuff... am I going to be alright...?

string.name: subject
string.value: Luke the Security Guy

string.name: req
string.value: Level 15, Beginners not allowed

string.name: desc
string.value: At the entrance of the dungeon, I met Luke the security guy. He wanted to make a healthy dish for his mom, and asked me if I could get him #b100 pieces of Jr. Necki's skin, 10 wings of Steezy, and a bowl of salad#k. He claimed that he's too busy with all the security matters and stuff, but ... he looks like he's just falling asleep at work ...

string.name: desc
string.value: I got Luke, who is protecting the entrance of the Dungeon, the stuff he asked for. Since he's making the "Snake Drink" and all ... I want a taste of that myself! In return, Luke got me a nicely refined jewel he found from around the area. It's not like a refined jewel drops from the sky ... did someone lose it while traveling? Anyway I should drop by later when the "Snake Drink" gets done ...

string.value: Kenta's Research 1

string.name: req
string.value: Level 17

string.name: desc
string.value: #bKenta#k, a veteran animal instructor at the Aquarium Zoo, seemed to be concerned over the fact that the animals at Aqua Road have been acting strangely since the storm that occurred not too long ago. I couldn't see the difference myself, but I'm sure the expert sees it differently.\n#bKenta#k wanted to investigate this phenomenon, and asked me to gather up the DNA samples of#b Seacle#k, #bCico#k and #bPinboom#k at Aqua Road.

string.name: req
string.value: Level 20, Beginner not allowed

string.name: desc
string.value: Underneath the watchtower at Henesys park, I met Pia, who was wearing a teddy bear costume. She was talking about how, on the way to Ellinia, she ran into a couple of blue mushrooms and had a hard time with them. She wanted me to show them who's the boss, and as a proof, she wanted #b60 blue mushroom tops and 60 green mushroom tops#k ... but I can see why she's being attacked anyway ... anyone that walks around wearing those is bound to be attacked !!!

string.value: I got Pia, who had been chilling under the watchtower at Henesys Park, the stuff she requested, #b60 blue mushroom tops and 60 green mushroom tops#k. For that, she got me the scroll for armor def. ... she said all I need to do is click on it at item window, and drag it to the armor. Simple, but ... what if this doesn't work ????

string.name: req
string.value: Level 20

string.name: desc
string.value: I met with #bChief Stan#k, who was at Henesys in Victoria Island. He handed me what appeared to be an old, sealed letter, and wanted me to deliver it to Dr. Kim of Omega Sector. He said to get to Omega Sector, I'll need to first get on board on a ship ride from Ellinia to Orbis, followed by the ride to Ludibrium from there.

string.name: desc
string.value: I met Dr. Kim at Omega Sector, and handed him the #bsealed letter#k that Chief Stan gave me. This place seems to be full of facilities designed in anticipation of the alien invasion... I should talk to Dr. Kim whenever I have a chance...

string.value: Shumi's Lost Coin

string.name: req
string.value: Level 20

string.name: desc
string.value: I met this girl name Shumi at Kerning City. She was devasted about losing the lucky coin that she borrowed from a friend and that she was asking me to find it for her. She also told me a bunch of guys draped in white cloth took it from her at the subway, so they may be found at the #bconstuction site B1#k, deep in the station ... I should get in there first ...

string.name: desc
string.value: At the #bconstuction site B1#k of the subway, I found what appears to be the coin that Shumi lost ... all I need to do now is return it to her ...

string.name: desc
string.value: I found the lost coin that Shumi of Kerning City was looking for, and returned it to her. A precious coin borrowed from her friend, huh ... as a reward, she gave me a whole bunch of the return scrolls ... not bad at all!! She also said other items can be found at #bconstruction site B1#k ... I should check it out later ...

string.name: subject
string.value: Alex the Runaway Kid

string.name: req
string.value: Level 20, Beginners not allowed

string.name: desc
string.value: At the top of the building in Kerning City, I met this kid named Alex, who looked like a runaway kid. He left home a few days ago aftter a spat with his father. He'd been wandering around Kerning City ever since, but now, with no money and a severe case of boredom hitting him, he just wanted to go back home ... with the problem being that he was certain that a whole round of spanking would await him if he did, indeed, return home. So he asked me if I could convince his father Stan, who happened to be the chief of Henesys, to let him return home without any incident. Not only that, he asked me to get his late mother's article, her #bold gold watch#k, from him as a proof. If he had known this would happen, would he have done it nonetheless?

string.name: desc
string.value: At the entrance of Henesys Park, I met Alex's father Stan, the chief of Henesys. I couldn't even start up a conversation with him at first, but once I got him #b50 Evil Eye's tails and 100 pig ribbons#k he requested to fix this town, that was when he decided to listen. He was even more straight-forward and difficult to talk to than I first thought, but I finally convinced him to accept Alex back with open arms. I also got Alex's late mother's #bgold watch#k as the proof. Now, all I need to do is get this watch to Alex in Kerning City, right?

string.name: desc
string.value: I gave Alex his late mother's #bgold watch#k. Hopefully this will get him home ... as a sign of appreciation, he got me an earing he received from friends he met while traveling here and there. Well, Alex is now forgiven by Stan, but based on the look of his face, I don't know if he really is going to head home right now ... I should check it out the next time I head over to Henesys ...

string.name: subject
string.value: Jack Shwetty's Secret Book

string.name: req
string.value: Level 30, Beginners not allowed.

string.name: desc
string.value: At a VIP sauna in Sleepywood, I met this bald man called #bJack Shwetty#k. He has a son, and apparently he ran away from home one day with a book that he cares deeply for. He requested that I find his son and get the book back from him. For a reward, he's offering me comfortable clothes for sauna... hmm... He also told me his son Ronnie hangs out at a tree tunnel around Ellinia, so maybe I can find him there. Anyway, is that book more important to him than his son?? What kind of a book is it anyway... ????

string.name: desc
string.value: Inside a tree tunnel around Ellinia I found #bRonnie#k, the son of Jack Shwetty. He said the red book is off limits, but he seems to be starving. In the end, we made a deal that I get him #b50 Lupin bananas, Rina's Unagi Special, and a fresh milk#k, and he gives me the book. According to Ronnie, I can find Rina at Henesys, and as for the fresh milk, I can get it from Rowen the fairy from Ellinia. I have a lot of traveling to do, but oh well...

string.name: desc
string.value: To get the Unagi special and a fresh milk, I need to gather up the ingredients for those. Rina of Henesys requested #b50 Curse Eye tails and 5 pig's heads#k for the Unagi special. Rowen the fairy of Ellinia asked for a refined piece of glittering #bdiamond#k for a fresh milk. Diamond, huh... how am I supposed to get that rare, expensive item?

string.name: desc
string.value: I got Ronnie all the food he needed, and got the #bSecret Book#k that Jack Shwetty had been desperately looking for... it's a weird-looking book with a red cover... I have a feeling that I should not open this book... Anyway I should hurry up and get this to Jack Shwetty at the VIP sauna in Sleepywood before it's too late.

string.name: desc
string.value: I got Jack Shwetty the precious Secret Book that he'd been desperately looking for. I asked him if he's worried about Ronnie at all, only to hear that he'll be in good hands with the fairies... well, it'd be best for Ronnie to be with the fairies, right? Anyway, I got the sauna clothes in return for the book... I guess wearing these cumbersome armors around sauna is a ridiculous thing to do. Might as well enjoy it now and chill here at the sauna...

string.value: Level 37

string.value: I got the materials needed for Icarus to make the flying balloon and realize his dream of flying. string.name: subject
string.value: Jane the Alchemist

string.name: req
string.value: Level 40, Beginners not allowed

string.name: desc
string.value: I ran into Jane again at Lith Harbor, the same Jane that I helped get wild boar's canine teeth for her to travel. She said she got busted for lying that it was her that collected those items...anyway, she gave up on her dream to travel, and now is trying to become an alchemist. She needed some materials to experiment with...and...I'm pretty sure I'm getting those for her. Anyway, she said she needed #b1 pure water, 30 medicines with weird vibe, and 20 malady's experimental frogs#k to try to make an Elixir. Oh, what the heck, I'll get them for her and see if it really works...

string.name: desc
string.value: I got all the materials needed for Jane to make the elixir. If she does it well, then maybe I can get myself a nice elixir, but what if she fails...is the whole place going to blow up??

string.name: desc
string.value: This time, Jane promised she'll make a better item, and wants me to get #b1 Mushmom's spore, 3 of Drake's blood, 100 medicine with weird vibes, and 30 Malady's experimental frogs#k. She said something about making a Power Elixir, the one that can restore both HP and MP at once...

string.name: desc
string.value: I got all the materials needed for Jane to make the elixir. If she does it well, then maybe I can get myself a nice elixir, but what if she fails...then I don't know if really want to take it...blehhh...

string.name: desc
string.value: This time, the last time, she promised to make me a mysterious scroll, and that she wanted me to get #ba moon rock, 20 dragon skins, and 10 saps of ancient tree#k for her. I guess I should ask the fairies at Ellinia for the moon rock, right?

string.name: desc
string.value: I got all the materials needed for Jane to make the scroll. Thankfully, the scroll for glove for ATT was made without a hitch, and she readily gave it to me. If the scroll really works, then I may have myself a dandy of a glove! Anyway, Jane expressed a strong desire to keep experimenting and become a good alchemist someday. Maybe next time I come back here, I may be able to buy an item from her that's not sold in store...nice...

string.name: desc
string.value: I found the #bscroll of life#k at #bCloy's house#k in Ludibrium. I gave this, along with the #bWater of Life#k, to Wisp and he helped turn my pet back alive. I need to have some play time with my pet now!

string.name: subject
string.value: Collecting Huckle's Magic Ingredients

string.name: desc
string.value: I met an old man named Huckle at the hidden room in the middle of Orbis Tower. He's been living in there for 30 years, studying the physics of the self-moving stones. He wants me to gather up #b45 Jr. Stoneball pieces of rock, 20 Ice Stoneball pieces of rock, and 20 Fire Stoneball pieces of rock#k. Alright, let's do this...

string.name: desc
string.value: I got Huckle, the old man living in the hidden room at the Orbis Tower, the items he had requested, and in return, got the Statue-Teleporting Scroll. It allows me to teleport between the statue at the 20th floor of Orbis Tower, and the 1st floor. Huckle looks like he needs more samples, so I guess I'll need to keep looking for those...

string.name: req
string.value: Level 40

string.name: desc
string.value: I met up with Wing the Fairy of Ellinia. He grabbed me and asked me if I wanted to explore to a new world and train myself there. Unfortunately, that's not what he really meant by it. He just wanted me to be the delivery person and get this item to his friend #bKriel the Fairy#k in Orbis.

string.name: desc
string.value: Kriel the Fairy seemed to be swamped with work, and asked me if I could help her out. She wanted me to walk around town, collect empty bottles, and collect materials needed to make weapons for magicians. I should bring #b20 empty potion bottles#k, #b200 solid horns#k, and #b50 Nependeath seeds#k.

string.name: desc

string.name: req
string.value: Level 42

string.name: desc

string.name: desc
string.value: #bWing the Fairy#k of Ellinia asked me to take the Flying Pill to Icarus. So this little pill is all it takes to fly? I need to get this to Icarus ASAP.

string.name: desc
string.value: I got Icarus the Flying Pill that Wing the Fairy of Ellinia made. I hope it works for him.

string.name: subject
string.value: Manji's Ragged Gladius

string.name: req
string.value: Level 45, Beginners not allowed

string.name: desc
string.value: I ran into Manji from Perion again, the same Manji that I met while I was helping the little Maya get her medicine. He was shocked by my stronger appearance, and wanted to ask me for a favor. Long long ago, he was in danger of being attacked by Balrog, only to be saved by the legendary hero Tristan. He died in place of Manji, and for that, he's been keeping that sword to this day. Too bad the sword has been soaked in Balrog's evilness and is as ragged as possible. It's too embarrassing to even call it a sword now. Anyway, he gave me the#r Ragged Gladius#k and wanted me to reawaken it for him. If it indeed gets reawaken, it becomes the #bHero's Gladius#k ...I should go see Chrishrama of Sleepywood just the way Manji said it...

string.name: desc
string.value: I found Chrishrama of Sleepywood, and showed him the #bragged Gladius#k that Manji gave me. He claimed to have made it himself, and that he needs a #bstar rock, 1 piece of ice, 1 ancient scroll, and 1 flaming feather#k. I've never heard of any of those, so I don't know how I'm going to even start with this...Chrishrama said the only way I can get is to talk to Mike who's guarding the entrace of the dungeon.

string.name: desc
string.value: I got all the materials needed to reawaken the sword to Chrishrama. He couldn't believe his eyes, but went on with it, and reawoke the sword into #bHero's Gladius#k. It gives off a mystic light...and it's a really nice sword! Hmmm...I don't know if I should really give it to him...

string.name: desc
string.value: It was tough, but I returned the reawaken #bHero's Gladius#k to Manji. He was ecstatic over it, and handed me a #bskull earring#k, an article left by his dead friend. I'm guessing he's accepting me now. It feels weird wearing a skull around my ear, but it's from Manji, so I should take care of it too...

string.name: desc
string.value: I returned to Manji with the reawaken #bHero's Gladius#k, but...I said no to his request to return the sword. He took care of it as if it was his life, and for me to say no to that, he must've been REALLY mad about it...he told me to get out of his sight right this minute...I can't talk to him anymore...now it won't work even if I tell him to take it...I'm happy about the sword I have now, but it just doesn't feel right...

string.value: I met Hoon at a Field around Omega Sector, and showed him the#b Blueprint Machine#k, as well as provide him with #b20 Space Foods#k. Hoon said that he fixed #bGwin's Laser Gun#k that he was asked to fix and requested me if I could give him his #bLaser Gun#k as well as show him the Blueprint Machine. He should be somewhere around the Field. Where could he be...

string.name: desc
string.value: I met up with Gwin at a field around Omega Sector, handed him his#b Laser gun#k, and showed him the#b Blueprint Machine#k. Gwin appreciated my effort and requested that I report this all to Dr. Kim. This Command Center warp capsule seems like a useful item.

string.name: desc
string.value: As Dr. Kim requested from the Command Center in the Omega Sector, I showed the blueprint of the new robot to Mirol, Hoon, and Gwin, while simultaneously solving their problems. string.value: Level 30

string.value: I saw Moppie in Orbis, and he seemed unresponsive to my commands. You could tell he's been waiting for his master for a long time judging from the wrinkly, dirty, unruly hair he features. I wanted to help him out, but I cannot understand whatever Moppie is uttering. I need someone as a translator so I can talk to him, but ... should I ask for a person, or a fairy?

string.name: desc
string.value: I had no idea what Moppie was saying, so I got to ask Lisa for some help.

string.name: desc
string.value: According to Lisa, there is a way to communicate with Moppie the dog, as long as the horn flute is there. They are usually featured by the fairies. Lisa promised to make one for me, as long as I gather up the necessary materials for it. I'll need #b100 solid horns#k, #b20 stiff feathers#k and #b10 leathers#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: Lisa of Orbis made me a horn flute. Hopefully this will help me finally understand what Moppie is saying...

string.name: desc
string.value: Thanks to the horn flute, I can clearly comprehend what Moppie is saying. What kind of help is Moppie looking for...?

string.name: desc
string.value: Thanks to the horn flute, I could finally understand what Moppie was saying. Apparently he was just sitting at the same spot waiting for his master until one day, he decided to take matters into his own hands (or paws) and wandered out of town. He was attacked by a monster, and he's been hurt ever since. I need to find someone that can help Moppie get healthy again.

string.name: desc
string.value: To make Lisa's Special Medicine, I'll need 40 Orange Potions, 20 Blue Potions, 1 Antidote, and ... 1 Fierry's Tentacle. Obtaining the Fierry's Tentacle is going to be difficult.

string.name: desc
string.value: Lisa's Special Medicine is finally made! The sweet scent of it just makes it look that much more appealing to me, and I'm sure it will for Moppie ... I better get to Moppie ASAP.

string.name: desc

string.value: I met up with Elma and received the #t4031308# that she borrowed 50 years ago. It looks like a significant amount of time has passed since I came here. I better get back to Spiruna's house immediately.

string.name: desc
string.value: I received the Cloud Sprayer from Elma the Housekeeper. The cloud fixing should be a breeze now with this in store. This better stop the freefall of Orbis.

string.name: subject
string.value: The View of the Ocean

string.name: req
string.value: Level 30

string.name: desc
string.value: Kriel, a proud owner of a set of wings, was blowing off travelers that weren't fortunate enough to have them. I don't think she has a clue that there are numerous breathtaking places that just cannot be reached by flying. According to Lisa, Kriel's not too enthused with the fact that she can only hear about the rumors of Aqua Road and not being able to go there in person. Anyway, Lisa suggested that I buy Kriel "The Official Aqua Road Photo Album" from #bMuse#k. Muse, huh... Another trip underwater...

string.name: desc
string.value: I met with Muse, the person who sells the Aquaroad Photo Album. Unfortunately, she mentioned that the photo album is sold out. After relentlessly asking her questions about it, she relented and told me she'll give me the photo album that she kept for herself. In return, she wanted me to show her a Snow Crystal Sphere, since she's never seen snow before in her life. #bSnow Crystal Sphere#k is made by #rAlcaster#k of El Nath.

string.name: desc
string.value: After receiving the request from Muse to see the Snow Crystal Sphere, I headed off to El Nath to see Alcaster. He seems to be pretty busy. I better pay another visit.

string.name: desc
string.value: Alcaster mentioned that, in order to make a Snow Crystal Sphere, I'll have to bring #b100 Snow Crystals#k to him. Snow Crystals can be found through the monster called #bLeatty#k, which lives in the Orbis Tower...

string.name: desc
string.value: I finally got the Snow Crystal Sphere from Alcaster. I have a feeling Muse's going to LOVE seeing this. I better head back to Aquarium and see #rMuse#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: I gave Muse the Snow Crystal Sphere, and in return, got myself the Official Aqua Road Photo Album. Now it's time for me to show this to Kriel in Orbis.

string.name: desc
string.value: I gave Muse the Snow Crystal Sphere and purchased the Official Aqua Road Photo Album, then gave it to Kriel for the viewing. After seeing her admit how beautiful Aqua Road is, I must say I felt validated by it, but it also seems like she set the whole thing up for this from the get go. Oh well, at least Kriel's happy, and that's good enough for me.

string.name: subject
string.value: Hoon's Toothache

string.name: req
string.value: Level 31

string.name: desc
string.value: I met with Hoon again at a field around Omega Sector. Hoon seemed to have an affinity for sweets, and it did not do his teeth any good. Now, he needed Pain Reliever to relieve the excruciating pain on his teeth. My job now is to get the #bPain Releiver#k from the Omega Sector, and give it to Hoon.

string.name: desc
string.value: I purchased the #bPain Reliever#k from Dr. Pepper at the Omega Sector Silo, and gave it to Hoon, who was at a field around Omega Sector. Seriously, enough with the sweets!

string.name: subject
string.value: The Drumming Bunny

string.name: req
string.value: Level 31

string.name: desc
string.value: I met up with Roly-Poly Worker 5 again at Eos Tower. He was complaining about the Drumming Bunnies that seem to be bothering him at the 60th floor, and requested that I collect #b100 Toy Drums#k for him. If I get this for him, then there may be more work in store...

string.name: desc
string.value: Just the way the Roly-Poly Worker 5 asked, I took out the drumming bunnies and collected the toy drums. He said his work got easier when I'm around, and he wants me to help him out on some other stuff. Maybe I should chill here and help these guys out for a change.

string.name: subject
string.value: Eliminating the Drumming Bunny

string.name: req
string.value: Level 31

string.name: desc
string.value: I met up with Roly-Poly Worker 5 again at Eos Tower. He thanked me for helping him out last time, and mentioned that I should have heard it from General Maester, but we'll have to take away the force of darkness and put it back to the way it used to be. He requested that I eliminate the Drumming Bunnies at the 60th floor of Eos Tower and collect #b1000 Toy Drums#k for him.

string.name: desc
string.value: Just the way the Roly-Poly Worker 5 asked, I took out the drumming bunnies and collected the toy drums. I think this really took out the wild bunnies as well as taking away the force of darkness. Here's hoping that those bunnies turn back to the old, adorable bunnies they used to be.

string.name: subject
string.value: The Ore of Dark Crystal

string.name: req
string.value: Level 31

string.name: desc
string.value: I met General Maester, who's in command of a humongous army at the Omega Sector. The general said we'll be able to obtain the powerless, lightless #bDull Crystal#k that have been used up at the Eos Tower from#b Drumming Bunnies#k. While most would dismiss the item as nothing more than a useless crystal, the general believed it had something important hidden in it, and that he requested me to gather up #b20 Dull crystals#k at the Eos Tower. I'll need to get those crystals from the Drumming Bunnies at the tower.

string.name: desc
string.value: Just like the way General Maester instructed, I went to Eos Tower, took out took out the Drumming Bunnies, and gathered up #b20 Dull crystals#k for him. While looking at the crystal, he mentioned that there must be something inside these crystals to turn these previously-adorable Drumming Bunnies to something of a menace. I wonder exactly what's inside it.

string.name: subject
string.value: Where's the Origin of Power?

string.name: req
string.value: Level 31

string.name: desc
string.value: I met General Maester, who's in command of a humongous army at the Omega Sector. The general said after investigating the dull crystals from the Drumming Bunnies, he realized that the aliens may have a clue about this, and instructed me to find Alien Gray. There may be an item around Alien Gray that may provide clues for this. Of course, it won't just cough up the item, so I may have to look around the area where it's at.

string.name: desc
string.value: Just like the way General Maester instructed, I found a hidden document that appeared to have been purposely hidden by Alien Gray. The general said, after putting the document through Alien Language Translator, it said a Dark Cryastal Ore with its dark force will turn a harmless doll into a monster. He wanted all the crystals gone before it gets too late.

string.name: subject
string.value: Terminating the Dark Force

string.name: req
string.value: Level 31

string.name: desc
string.value: I met General Maester, who's in command of a humongous army at the Omega Sector, again. The general said although a perfect solution hasn't been presented yet, there's something for me to do. He wanted me to bring back #b30 Dull Crystals#k and #b10 Dark Crystal Ores#k from the Drumming Bunnies at the Eos Tower.

string.name: desc
string.value: Just like the way General Maester instructed, I gathered up the #bDull Crystals#k and #bDark Crystal Ores#k from the Drumming Bunnies. Hopefully this'll stop the bunnies for a while, but this ain't over. I wonder when peace will actually settle on the Eos Tower.

string.name: subject
string.value: A Delivery to a Lost Time

string.name: req
string.value: Level 33

string.name: desc
string.value: Olson the Toy Soldier from the 100th floor of Eos Tower wanted me to get the #bpendulum#k obtained from the monster disguised as the dollhouse to Grandpa Clock at the Lost Time somewhere inside the Clocktower. Apparently the Grandpa Clock should be able to fix him.

string.name: desc
string.value: At the Lost Time in the Ludibrium Clocktower, I gave Grandpa Clock the #bpendulum#k, an essential part of the clocktower. Now all I have to do is wait for the Grandpa Clock to fix the clocktower. Will this work?

string.name: subject
string.value: Grandpa Clock's Crisis

string.name: req
string.value: Level 33

string.name: desc
string.value: After obtaining the #bpendulum#k by destroying the dollhouse the monster disguised as, I went down to the Lost Time to find Grandpa Clock. But it seemed like instead of him helping me fix the clocktower, he was about to die first, so he wanted me to take down some monsters called #bTick-Tock#k and pick up the #ball-purpose clock spring#k that they possess. I better get them before Grandpa Clock dies.

string.name: desc
string.value: I gave Grandpa Clock the #ball- purpose clock spring#k from Tick-Tock's at the Lost Time in the Ludibrium Clocktower. I'm glad I got to give this to him before too late...

string.name: subject
string.value: Rocky's Parts

string.name: req
string.value: Level 34

string.name: desc
string.value: I met up with Rocky the Repairman at the Toy Factory in Ludibrium Clocktower. Rocky seemed to be swamped with work due to a sudden increase in monsters destroying parts here and there. He was worried about running out of essential parts, so he asked me if I could gather up #b50 cogwheels#k and #b30 screws#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: At the Toy Factory in Ludibrium, I gave Rocky the cogwheels and screws needed for him to fix anything that is broken. Hopefully that was enough to undo the damages done by those pesky monsters.

string.name: subject
string.value: The Clocktower Headache

string.name: req
string.value: Level 34

string.name: desc
string.value: Deep in the Lost Time of Ludibrium, I met up with Grandpa Clock. He seemed to be annoyed by the fact that the tiny Tickys have been going inside the clocktower and destroy parts of it, making his job much harder than it should have been. For the sake of Grandpa Clock, I'll need to take out #b100 Tickys#k.\n\nTickys to kill : #r#a10026051##k

string.name: desc
string.value: Deep in the Lost Time of Ludibrium, I met up with Grandpa Clock. He seemed to be annoyed by the fact that the tiny Tickys have been going inside the clocktower and destroy parts of it, making his job much harder than it should have been. For the sake of Grandpa Clock, I'll need to take out #b100 Tickys#k. Looks like I killed them all!\n\nTickys to kill : #b#a10026051##k

string.name: desc
string.value: I took care of the request Grandpa Clock made, by taking out the#b Tickys#k. The Tickys were another one of the reasons the clocktower seemed to have something wrong at all times, so this should give Grandpa Clock a good night's sleep.

string.value: Eos Tower Threatened!

string.name: req
string.value: Level 35

string.name: desc
string.value:
Marcel of Ludibrium asked me to take care of #b25 Block Gollems#k and #b15 King Block Gollems#k that seem prevalent around Eos Tower.

Block Gollems to kill : #r#a10021031##k
King Block Gollems to kill : #r#a10021032##k

string.name: desc
string.value:
Marcel of Ludibrium asked me to take care of #b25 Block Gollems#k and #b15 King Block Gollems#k that seem prevalent around Eos Tower. I think I defeated them all.

Block Gollems to kill : #b#a10021031##k
King Block Gollems to kill : #b#a10021032##k

string.name: desc
string.value: I took care of the #bBlock Gollems#k and #bKing Bllock Golems#k that Marcel of Ludibrium asked me to do. Now the monsters threatening the tower have disappeared... it looks like there's a new terrifying monster...

string.name: subject
string.value: Where is Dogon's HQ?

string.name: req
string.value: Level 35

string.name: desc
string.value: I met with Mirol at the Silo of the Omega Sector again, and he requested that I find a secret base of an apparent alien-worshipper. I'll need to find Dogon's HQ, which is hidden somewhere around the Fields nearby Omega Sector, find #bDogon's Report#k from the box at the Dogon's HQ, and give them to Mirol.

string.name: desc
string.value: I gave Mirol, who was waiting for me at the Silo of the Omega Sector, the #bDogon's Report#k that I found from Dogon's secret base. I can't believe someone is actually helping aliens... now THAT's quite shocking.

string.name: subject
string.value: Helping Fix Eos Tower

string.name: req
string.value: Level 35

string.name: desc
string.value: I met up with Roly-Poly 8 again at Eos Tower. He seemed worried that there's a lot of places to fix at Eos Tower, only to have the monsters stop him from doing so. He asked if I could take out #b30 King Bloctopuses#k and collect #b25 Plastic Crowns#k in the process. I should give it a go...\n\nKing Bloctopuses to kill : #r#a10041001##k

string.name: desc
string.value: I met up with Roly-Poly 8 again at Eos Tower. He seemed worried that there's a lot of places to fix at Eos Tower, only to have the monsters stop him from doing so. He asked if I could take out #b30 King Bloctopuses#k and collect #b25 Plastic Crowns#k in the process. I should give it a go...\n\nKing Bloctopuses to kill : #b#a10041001##k

string.name: desc
string.value: I took out a bunch of King Bloctopuses and collected Plastic Crowns just the way the Roly-Poly 8 of Eos Tower asked. How long is this maintenance job going to last anyway? This should get done soon so I don't have to do them any more favors.

string.name: subject
string.value: Protect Nero!

string.name: req
string.value: Level 35

string.name: desc
string.value:
Ericsson had been livid towards the monsters right outside Orbis that have made life miserable for Nero. He wanted me to teach those monsters a lesson by taking out #b50 Jr. Cellions, 50 Jr. Lioners, and 50 Jr. Grupins#k while bring back #b50 solid horns#k with me.

Jr. Cellion to kill : #r#a10062011##k
Jr. Lioner to kill : #r#a10062012##k
Jr. Grupin to kill : #r#a10062013##k

string.name: desc
string.value:
I took out all the monsters that have been making life miserable for Nero. Now I just need to bring back the
#b50 solid horns#k to Ericsson as evidence.

Jr. Cellion to kill : #b#a10062011##k
Jr. Lioner to kill : #b#a10062012##k
Jr. Grupin to kill : #b#a10062013##k

string.name: desc
string.value: Ericsson was livid towards the fact that the monsters outside Orbis had been making his cat Nero's life miserable, so with his blessing, I proceeded to teach those monsters a lesson or two.

string.name: subject
string.value: Hughes's Hobby

string.name: req
string.value: Level 35

string.name: desc
string.value: At a small dinky room in the basement of the Orbis Tower, which also happened to have flooded, I met up with Hughes the Fuse. I accidentally broke Hughes's favorite toy baby seal. He proceeded to really get angry and demanded that I take out #b50 Scuba Pepes#k and bring back #b10 toy baby seals#k.\n\nScuba Pepes to kill : #r#a10063001##k

string.name: desc
string.value: At a small dinky room in the basement of the Orbis Tower, which also happened to have flooded, I met up with Hughes the Fuse. I accidentally broke Hughes's favorite toy baby seal. He proceeded to really get angry and demanded that I take out #b50 Scuba Pepes#k and bring back #b10 toy baby seals#k. I think I took out enough.\n\nScuba Pepes to kill : #b#a10063001##k

string.name: desc
string.value: I accidentally broke Hughes's Toy Baby Seal, so I got him some Toy Baby Seal as well as kill off some Scuba Pepe's. Fortunatelly, Hughes seems to be okay by now.

string.name: subject
string.value: Hughes's Weird Invention

string.name: req
string.value: Level 35

string.name: desc
string.value: I went to the basement of the Orbis Tower to see the mad scientist, Hughes. He claimed to have invented an equipment that will allow us to breathe underwater. Not bad... He said with #b50 snorkles#k, #b50 air bubbles#k, #b5 steel plates#k and #b30 screws#k, he can also make one for me. I better start gathering up...

string.name: desc
string.value: I went to the basement of the Orbis Tower where Hughes lives, gave Hughes all the materials needed, and got #bOxygen Tank#k in return, to breathe underwater.

string.name: subject
string.value: Hughes's Research Material

string.name: req
string.value: Level 35

string.name: desc
string.value: The mad scientist living at the basement of Orbis, Hughes, wanted me to gather up #b20 seal skins#k and #b20 seal teeth#k for his new research.

string.name: desc
string.value: I got him seal skin and seal teeth for his research.

string.name: subject
string.value: Lost in the Ocean

string.name: req
string.value: Level 35

string.name: desc
string.value: I got a hold of a letter of help from someone who had been sent somewhere near the current at Aquarium. I wonder where exactly the writer is?

string.name: desc
string.value: I picked up a letter of help from someone. Through the dry sand inside the glass bottle, I was able to find Robinson, who had been asking for help for a while. He seemed tired from the long solitary stay at the island, and he wanted to me to get him a bottle of Pure Water too.

string.name: desc
string.value: I met Robinson in the middle of the island right at the center of the ocean, and he said that he used be a pilot for the army of Omega Sector, but while in a combat against the aliens, he ran away from the scene, only to be swept by strong currents that led you to where you were. He wishes to get back to the Omega Sector, but currently we have no idea where we are, and he's been covered with scars. As a result, he asked me if I can go to the Omega Sector, notify #bKay#k of his troubles, and ask for some relief. Where is the Omega Sector?

string.name: desc
string.value: I went to see #bKay#k at the Omega Sector, and handed him a card of Robinson's ID. He said everyone's been wondering of his whereabouts, and wanted me to describe the position of the island in detail. He complained of the lack of members available due to the battle against the aliens, and asked me if I could give this warp capsule, specially made in Omega Sector, to Robinson. A warp capsule that takes the person to the Omega Sector regardless of the place of origin? That's awesome!! I want to take it myself for a split second, until I found out that only the Omega Sector members can use it. Darn it...

string.name: desc
string.value: Kay needed help from me, since he couldn't send the rescuers to save Robinson, and so I got the specially-made warp capsule and gave it to Robinson. Now he can go back to the Omega Sector and get himself fixed.

string.name: subject
string.value: Assembling a Toy

string.name: req
string.value: Level 36

string.name: desc
string.value: I ran into #bHans#k, the toy assembler at the Toy Factory in Ludibrium. He made a proposal where if I get him some parts for a toy, then he'll assemble it and make something fun out of it. This is sweet! The things I'll need are #b20 cheap batteries from the Robo, 20 metal hearts of Master Robo, and 30 cogwheels of Chronos#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: At the toy factory in Ludibrium, I gave Hans the parts needed to assemble a toy. Hans put together the parts and made a very unique sack out of it. He said he put some toys inside, but... I don't know, something may pop up that'll scare the daylight out of me. I better be careful with it...

string.name: subject
string.value: Eliminating Grays

string.name: req
string.value: Level 37

string.name: desc
string.value: At a field around Omega Sector, I met this strangely-dressed man who called himself Black Mesoranger. He requested that I eliminate the alien that's been taking over Kulan Plain, the #bBarnard Gray#k, 30 of them to be exact.\n\nBarnard Grays left : #r#a10031001##k

string.name: desc
string.value: I successfully completed the mission from Black Mesoranger by defeating the #b 30 Barnard Grays#k in the field around Omega Sector. I should return to Black Mesoranger to deliver the news...\n\nBarnard Grays left : #b#a10031001##k

string.name: desc
string.value: I successfully completed the mission from Black Mesoranger by defeating the #bBarnard Grays#k. It seems, however, that there will be much more dangerous aliens monsters around Kulan Plain...

string.name: subject
string.value: Kenta's Research 3

string.name: req
string.value: Level 37

string.name: desc
string.value: I met up with Kenta, the animal instructor at Aquarium Zoo, again. This time, he mentioned that the fish near Aquarium have generally transformed more than others, and that he wanted to find out the conditions of the living organisms at the east coast and west coast. He wanted me to gather up another set of DNA samples of #bPuper#k, #bSparker#k and #bFreezer#k for him.

string.name: desc
string.value: I helped Kenta, the animal instructor at Aquarium Zoo, out again. So the animals in Aqua Road have been slowly changing in a negative way without anyone noticing... why is that happening? Can Kenta find out?

string.name: subject
string.value: The Alarm Clock

string.name: req
string.value: Level 38

string.name: desc
string.value: I met up with #bPink Mesoranger#k at the Roswell Plain near Omega Sector, and she looked very concerned over her never-ending habit of oversleeping. She asked if I could get her 20 #bTable Clocks#k that are dropped from monster #bTick-Tock#k. I better start heading down to the bottom of the Ludibrium Clocktower.

string.name: desc
string.value: I gathered up #bTable Clocks#k for Pink Mesoranger, who was stationed somewhere around Omega Sector, so she can overcome her chronic oversleeping. But then again, she always had trouble waking up, so I may have to find something more powerful for her...

string.name: subject
string.value: Assembling the Alarm Clock

string.name: req
string.value: Level 38

string.name: desc
string.value: I met Pink Mesoranger again at a field around Omega Sector. I was expecting her to tell me that she's been waking up on time, only to find out that all of her clocks have been destroyed. She said she needed a special alarm clock, and to make it will require #b2 Special Batteries, 10 Cogwheels, and 10 Table Clocks#k. To obtain the special batteries, I'll have to defeat Master Robo at the Ludibrium Clocktower.

string.name: desc
string.value: To make a special alarm clock for Pink Mesoranger, stationed at a field around Omega Sector, I gathered up a bunch of #bSpecial Batteries, Cogwheels, and Table Clocks#k as materials. I sure hope this clock does not break on her.

string.name: subject
string.value: Delivering the Alarm Clock

string.name: req
string.value: Level 38

string.name: desc
string.value: I ran into Pink Mesoranger again at Roswell Plain, near the Omega Sector. She said that the items I gathered up for her last time has been sent to #bKevin the Soldier#k of Omega Sector, and that he should be ready with the #bSuper Alarm Clock#k. My task is to get it from him for her. I hope she'll be able to wake up on time with this baby.

string.name: desc
string.value: I received the #bSuper Alarm Clock#k from #bKevin the Soldier#k, who was at the Omega Sector, for Pink Mesoranger. Now all I have to do is deliver this to her.

string.name: desc
string.value: #bKevin the Soldier#k made the #bsuper alarm clock#k for Pink Mesoranger, stationed at a field around Omega Sector, and I delivered it to her. Hopefully this will enable her to wake up on time.

string.name: subject
string.value: The Clock Workers' Batteries

string.name: req
string.value: Level 39

string.name: desc
string.value: I met up with Grandpa Clock deep inside the abandoned time of Ludibrium. Grandpa Clock admitted since he's an old fella, the spring was needed to rewind himself back to life, but the younger clock workers these days are all battery-operated, only to have some of them not have adequate batteries and thus not working the way it should be. I should collect #b200 cheap batteries#k for the sake of those clocks in need of them.

string.name: desc
string.value: I got the cheap batteries needed for the new battery-operated worker clocks. Grandpa Clock seemed ecstatic over the prospect of those workers finally showing life and lessening his work burden in the process. Anyway, what exactly are they doing in there...?

Rice really wanted me to keep it a secret, since this was something even the famous Dr. Pepper was unaware of, and he's thinking of making a patent out of it. Well, time to collect some tentacles!

string.value: Rice the Medic of Omega Sector requested the #b100 Matian \nTentacles#k, and I gathered up all of them. Will the research start now? I wonder what kind of the antidote this will produce. I should go see Rice right about the time when the tentacles run out.

string.value: I found #bMars#k hiding next to a building at the Alpha Sector. He has been sneaking around here since an alien stole his #bLaser Gun#k. Maybe I can find his weapon from one of the aliens walking around.

string.name: req
string.value: Level 40

string.value: Ericsson was way too busy playing around with his cats and not have enough time making the sap of Nependeath. What can I do to make one? Maybe I should talk to someone nearby...

string.name: desc
string.value: I got Ericsson a present for his cat, and he was so ecstatic over it that he promised to make me a #bSap of Nependeath#k if I get him #b200 Nependeath seeds#k and #b100 Dark Nependeath seeds#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: I got the #bSap of Nependeath#k from Ericsson. I should take this to #bElma the Housekeeper#k immediately!

string.name: desc
string.value: Elma promised me to fix me a nice Nependeath Juice, but she'll need the following ingredients to do so... #b1 sap of Nependeath#k, #b1 sweet\nsyrup#k, #b1 of Nependeath's honey#k and #b20 coconuts#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: Elma fixed me a tasty-looking Nependeath Juice. I better get this to Alfonse Green quickly!

string.name: desc
string.value: I've never seen anyone so happy over a glass of juice as Alfonse Green was with his glass of Nependeath Juice.

Green Mesoranger seemed genuinely surprised by the fact that I took care of all the missions, and told me it'd be a pleasure to work with me again. Now, THAT felt good!

string.name: subject
string.value: Eliminating Chief Gray

string.name: req
string.value: Level 43

string.name: desc
string.value: I met with Black Mesoranger again at a field around Omega Sector. She wanted me to take out #bChief Grays#k, considered as a high rank among the Grays, as well as collect 3 of their #bnotes#k from them. Chief Grays are very rare among all Grays and they are few and far between. How am I going to find them?

string.name: desc
string.value: I took 3 #bnotes#k from the Chief Grays and gave them to Black Mesoranger, who was at a field around Omega Sector. Apparently, these notes contain the history of the Grays... hopefully these notes can be deciphered soon!

string.name: subject
string.value: Trading with Alien Gray

string.name: req
string.value: Level 44

string.name: desc
string.value: I ran into #bAlien Gray#k at Kulan Plain around Omega Sector. He claimed that it's the Omega Sector, not them, that's been the bad one, and it asked me to help it invade the Sector by getting a number of materials from the Omega Sector Silo. I really don't feel good about helping it, but... oh well... I'll need to enter the Omega Sector Silo and bring out #b3 Secret Documents#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: I got the 3 secret documents out of the Silo and handed them to #bAlien Gray#k, which was at Kulan Plain of Omega Sector. I was richly rewarded for my effort, but I can't believe I fell for Gray's lies... I better hope the Omega Sector does not find out about the fact that I actually helped out the aliens...
