string.value: The Effort to Make-up

string.name: req
string.value: Level 44

string.name: desc
string.value: I met with Yellow Mesoranger at a field around Omega Sector. She alerted me that she's aware of the fact that I helped out Alien Gray, and that if I am to dispel the notion that I'm on the alien's side, I'll have to make an effort to make-up for my blunders. In order to regain their trust, I'll have to eliminate the aliens.\n\nUltra Grays to kill : #r#a10034011##k

string.name: desc
string.value: To regain trust from Yellow Mesoranger who knows I helped the Aliens, I had to eliminate them. I think I have killed enough~\n\nUltra Grays to kill : #b#a10034011##k

string.name: desc
string.value: I may have helped out Alien Gray in a moment of chaos, but after successfully completing the mission Yellow Mesoranger gave me, I think I regained some of her trust. It just seems like the aliens do not want to peacefully coexist with us.

string.name: subject
string.value: Collecting Meteorite Samples

string.name: req
string.value: Level 44

string.name: desc
string.value: I met up with Yellow Mesoranger again at a field around Omega Sector. Displaying her faith in me, she requested that I pick up #b6 Meteorite Samples#k that's been scattered all over Kulan Plain for further investigation. If I take care of this mission, I'll probably gain some more of her trust...

string.name: desc
string.value: I investigated all the meteorites that were scattered in Kulan Plain, and all #b6 Meteorite Samples#k have been collected. I should bring these to Yellow Mesoranger...

string.name: desc
string.value: I gathered up the meteorite samples from the Kulan Plain and gave them to Yellow Mesoranger, who was at a field around Omega Sector. Hopefully this will jumpstart the studies.

string.name: subject
string.value: The History of Zeta Leticulan

string.name: req
string.value: Level 45

string.name: desc
string.value: I met Black Mesoranger again at a field around Omega Sector. She said the notes have been deciphered, and they revealed that the original planet in which the Grays lived in has been affected with lethal contaminants. Ever since then, they've been looking for a new place to live in, and the Earth turned out to be an ideal place for them. She said that she needed to see which lethal containments aliens couldn't stand that currently infest their original planet, and requested that I extract the #bskin cells of Barnard Gray, Zeta Gray, Ultra Gray, and Chief Gray#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: I extracted the cells of #bBarnard Gray, Zeta Gray, Ultra Gray, and Chief Gray#k, and handed them to Black Mesoranger, who was at a field around Omega Sector. If the pollutants are poisonous enough for them to leave the planet for good, then our planet may not be safe for much longer...

string.name: subject
string.value: Chief Gray's Sign

string.name: req
string.value: Level 47

string.name: desc
string.value: I met up with Gwin again at a field around Omega Sector. Lately Gwin has been on a mission to trace Chief Gray's every move, but due to the fact that he gets lost easily, he had been having trouble locating it. I'll need to defeat Chief Gray's for Gwin and collect 5 signs that they wear with them, so I can give them to Gwin.

string.name: desc
string.value: I collected Chief Gray's signs and gave them to Gwin, who's at a field around Omega Sector. With this sign, Gwin may be able to have an easier time tracing Chief Gray.

string.name: subject
string.value: Fuel for MT-09

string.name: req
string.value: Level 50

string.name: desc
string.value: I met an engineer named Kay at the Omega Sector Silo. She said she'd been looking for an assistant, and asked if I could help her out. For my first task, since she's trying to develop a new machine that recycles MT-09's fuel, she wanted me to collect #b5 MT-09's Fuels#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: I went around and collected the fuel for MT-09. This was for Kay the Engineer, who was at the Silo of the Omega Sector. I wonder what kind of a machine Kay will make with the fuel...

string.name: subject
string.value: The Control Program for Rombard

string.name: req
string.value: Level 50

string.name: desc
string.value: I met Kay the Engineer again at the Silo of the Omega Sector. She first wanted to make sure that I didn't forget that I volunteered to be her assistant. Then, she said she needed a number of memory cards that contain Rombard Control Program, and asked me to collect 3 #bRombard's Memory Cards#k, which can be found through Rombard the monster at the Eos Tower. Then, I'll have to pay a visit to #bPorter#k at the Command Center in the Omega Sector and have him decipher the memory cards, and then hand her the #b3 Deciphered Memory Cards#k to her.

string.name: desc
string.value: I met #bPorter#k at the Command Center in the Omega Sector and gave him Rombard's 3 memory cards, but oh my... he was unable to decipher one of the three, and destroyed it. I'll need to find another one of Rombard's Memory Card for Porter.

string.name: desc
string.value: Once again, I gave #bPorter#k Rombard's Memory Cards. Fortunately, the deciphering worked this time around, and I was able to get a hold of #b3 Deciphered Memory Cards#k for Kay. Now all I have to do is give them to her.

string.name: desc
string.value: I gave Kay, who's at the Silo of Omega Sector, the #bDeciphered Memory Cards#k that she requested. I'm anxious to see what she makes out of them.

string.name: subject
string.value: The Missing Dropship

string.name: req
string.value: Level 50

string.name: desc
string.value: #bPorter#k, who's at the Command Center in the Omega Sector, requested that I deliver a letter to#b Kay the Engineer#k at the Omega Sector Silo. This letter has to be delivered on time, so I'll have to hurry up and give it to her. I wonder what's written in this though... maybe it's a love letter. Hahaha.

string.name: desc
string.value: I was able to hand #bPorter#k's letter from the Command Center in the Omega Sector to #bKay the Engineer#k, who was at the Omega Sector Silo, on time. I was expecting it to be a love letter, to no avail. Instead, it was about the missing dropship, and its current location. That's boring... anyway, Kay requested that I find the Dropship, which should be somewhere around Roswell Plain, and check out the pilot's livelihood.

string.name: desc
string.value: I found what appeared to be a broken Dropship around Roswell Plain, but the pilot is nowhere to be found, and instead, I was able to find a letter inside. I better give that letter to Kay.

string.name: desc
string.value: I found a letter inside the broken Dropship, and gave it to #bKay the Engineer#k at the Omega Sector Silo. With a sad look on her eyes, Kay said she was glad to find out the pilot was at least alive. Now, where would that pilot be...?

string.name: subject
string.value: A Spell that Seals Up a Critical Danger

string.name: req
string.value: Level 50

string.name: desc
string.value: I need to gather up 33 Cold Steam from Cold Eye that'll be used in a spell that can only be conducted by the Insignificant Being.

string.name: desc
string.value: The Insignificant Being said he needs to gather up the ingredients necessary to use as a spell to seal up the danger that's been spread all over the deep regions of the Dungeon.

string.name: desc
string.value: I need to gather up the items that the Insignificant Being needs to seal up the curse. The items are: 33 Wild Cargo's Spirit Rocks, 18 Tauromacis Spirit Rocks, and 18 Taurospear Spirit Rocks ...

string.name: desc
string.value: I gathered up the spirit rocks for Wild Cargo, Taurmacis, and even Taurospear. Is there more left?

string.name: subject
string.value: Looking for a Book of Ancient

string.name: req
string.value: Level 55

string.name: desc
string.value: I met #bAlcaster#k, the archeologist, at Elnath. He said he had heard about #b"book of ancient"#b, which tells about the Great World War, happened hundreds years ago. Hmm… interesting…The only offspring of "book of ancient" 's author is #bHella#k living in Orbis. I better go to find her right now~

string.name: desc
string.value: #bHella#k, the lone surviving descendent of the author of the "Book of Ancient", has been missing for a while… Where can I find her?

string.name: desc
string.value: It was #bHella#k who was the assistant of old Spiruna, living in Orbis Park. She said she said she lost the book in the snowfield. Jade said that I better look for the book in the #bgrave#k at the snowfield.

string.name: desc
string.value: I found the #bold ring#k at the little grave. Well… What should I do with this?... Well… No idea~…. Since there is nobody else, I should bring this to #bAlcaster#k, first…

string.name: desc
string.value: I accepted Scadur's request and I heard I should bring this ring to #bThe Four Wisemen at the Victoria Island#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: I met the Four Wisemen at the Victoria Island and got #b4 pieces of the map#k, which probably indicates where the "Book of Ancient" is. I better get back to Alcaster~

string.name: desc
string.value: To put 4 pieces of maps together, I should have #bmemory powder#k… I heard #bCorporal Easy#k have it… I better go to Orbis…

string.name: desc
string.value: Corporal Easy and I had a deal. If I give him #b3 toenails of Werewolf#k, he would give me memory powder for return. Hmm… Werewolf… It might be tough… I should give it a try…

string.name: desc
string.value: I got the #bmemory powder#k from Corporal Easy. Well.. it is time to go back to Alcaster~

string.name: desc
string.value: Alcaster made four pieces of maps to a whole map by using memory powder. According to the map, #bThe Book of Ancient#k is at the bottom of the unknown sculpture in Orbis Tower.

string.name: desc
string.value: I finally got #bThe Book of Ancient#k. I should go back to Alcaster right now~

string.name: desc
string.value: I finally gave #bThe Book of Ancient#k to Alcaster and I got the special cape for return. He said he would focus on sealing this book… I wish him the best luck for his work…

string.name: subject
string.value: Missing Hella

string.name: req
string.value: Level 55

string.name: desc
string.value: As Alcaster said, I went to the Hella's house in Orbis, but the only person I could meet was #bElma#k, the housekeeper of Hella. Elma said Hella had been missing for few months… She also said that #bJade in El Nath#k was the best friend of Hella. I better meet him…

string.name: desc
string.value: I asked Jade about Hella, but he didn't know where she is, either. Since there is nobody else to ask about her, I should ask Jade, one more time…

string.name: desc
string.value: Jade said Hella might went out to get #bstolen articles left by her mother#k. He suggested me to go back to Hella's house once again and ask Elma about Hella.

string.name: desc
string.value: Elma had heard from Hella about the #bold lady#k before she became missing. Elma said I should ask Jade about old lady.

string.name: desc
string.value: Jade said the old lady Hella talked about might be #bSpiruna#k living in Orbis Park.

string.name: desc
string.value: The assistant of #bOld Spiruna#k was Hella!

string.name: desc
string.value: I got the request from Hella to bring #bher pendant#k to Jade. She also said that she had lost the Book of Ancient in the snowfield. Well… I better go back to Jade.

string.name: desc
string.value: I gave Jade #bHella's Pendant#k and told him Hella lost the Book of Ancient in snowfield. Jade said I better look for the book in the #blittle grave#k at the snowfield, Well… anyway It is good to let him know Hella is okay…

string.name: subject
string.value: Black Crystal of Old Spiruna

string.name: req
string.value: Level 55

string.name: desc
string.value: I went to Spiruna's house in the Orbis Park to meet Hella. But Spiruna acts like she doesn't even know Hella. But I am sure she does...

string.name: desc
string.value: This old lady... Errr....

string.name: desc
string.value: Let see who wins!!!

string.name: desc
string.value: I am sure she knows Hella... Err... I will keep asking her till she answers me...

string.name: desc
string.value: Oh my god... I will ask, one last time...

string.name: desc
string.value: Spiruna said she would tell me anything if I get the #bblack crystal#k , which she has lost when she went out to get some herbs couple of days ago.

string.name: desc
string.value: I found Spiruna's #bblack crystal#k under the rock, but it is broken… Well… anyway…I should go back to Spiruna.

string.name: desc
string.value: Well…Well…Well… Spiruna yelled at me and said it was me who broke the black crystal… I should ask for the help to the girl living with Spiruna…

string.name: desc
string.value: The girl said the only way I can calm Spiruna down is to find the #bfairy powder#k, which can fix broken black crystal. Hella said #bKriel the Fairy#k in the Orbis potion shop might have the #bfairy powder#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: #bKriel the Fairy#k said that I should bring #b100 Star Pixie's Starpieces#k, #b50 Lunar Pixie's Moonpieces#k and #b30 Luster Pixie's Sunpieces#k. Time to hunt some Pixies~

string.name: desc
string.value: I gave everything #bKriel the Fairy#k asked for and got the #bfairy powder#k for return. I should get back to Spiruna now.

string.name: desc
string.value: Once Spiruna gets the #bfairy powder#k, she starts talking to me and says her assistant is #bHella#k. Oh my goodness… I even talked to her and I did not know who she was? string.name: subject
string.value: Scadur the Hunter

string.name: req
string.value: Level 55

string.name: desc
string.value: I finally got a hold of the #bold ring#k from the corpse at the small grave Jade told me to go to. This should hold the key to finding the #bBook of Ancient#k … anyway, I should go talk to #bAlcaster#k about it.

string.name: desc
string.value: I visited Scadur the hunter of El Nath with the #bold ring#k, but instead, I had that ring taken away from me.

string.name: desc
string.value: #bScadur#k bargained with me that the price of wolf skin has skyrocketed, and that if I get him 100 tails of Hector and 100 tails of White Pang, then he'll return the ring, along with telling me everything he knows about everything.

string.name: desc
string.value: I got the items Scadur wanted, and I got my #bold ring#k back. He told me he had heard about the ring back in the day from the four wisemen in Victoria Island, and recommended that I go visit each of the #bfour wisemen#k. He also wanted me to see the wiseman at #bPerion#k first, and foremost.

string.name: subject
string.value: The Four Wisemen at the Victoria Island

string.name: req
string.value: Level 55

string.name: desc
string.value: I showed the wiseman of Perion, #bSitting Bull#k the ring, and, much to my delight, he told me he has an item that can hold the key to finding the Book of Ancient. Of course, he wanted me to get something for him for that. He wanted #b2 Power Crystals#k to recover health, and then he'll give me the clues for the Book of Ancient.

string.name: desc
string.value: I handed Sitting Bull the 2 Power Crystals he had requested, and in return, I got the 1st #bold piece of map#k. The map has been split into four pieces, each of them taken care of by each of the four wisemen. I've also been requested to collect all four, and then use it to find the book and then seal it up for good. Now I got to go see the wiseman from #bEllinia#k…

string.name: desc
string.value: The wiseman of Ellinia, #bHines#k, has promised me to give me the 2nd piece of the map, provided that I get him #b2 Wisdom Crystals#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: I handed Hines the two crystals of wisdom, and I got the 2nd #bold piece of map#k. Now I got to go see the wiseman from #bHenesys#k…

string.name: desc
string.value: The wiseman of Henesys, #bHelena#k, has promised me to give me the 3rd piece of the map, provided that I get her #b2 Dexterity Crystals#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: I handed Helena the 2 Dexterity Crystals, and I got the 3rd #bold piece of map#k in return. Now I got to go see the wiseman from #bKerning City#k...

string.name: desc
string.value: The wiseman of Kerning City, #bDark Road#k, has promised me to give me the 3rd piece of the map, provided that I get him #b2 crystals of luck#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: I've met all four wisemen at the Victoria Island, and came away with the #b4 pieces of the old map#k. I guess my job now is to find the Book of Ancient and safely seal it up for good, just the way they envisioned it. Now I better head off to El Nath and see Alcaster.

string.value: Preparing For the Revival

string.name: req
string.value: Level 55

string.name: desc
string.value: I met Shammos at the basement of Chief's Residence. Apparently a plan from back then had backfired and rendered him to where he is today ... it seems like he was planning up something sinister, and the four chiefs found out about it and sealed him up. Anyway, he looks really intimidating, and he seems to be cooking up something terrible again. He's not telling me what it is, but he wants me to head over to Perion to get the item he needs. Am I doing the right thing by helping him out?

string.name: desc
string.value: Manji told me some things about the #b#t4031218##k. I couldn't believe what I was hearing. #b#t4031218##k can bring the dead's back to life, and the source of its energy is apparently #b#t4031218##k. That's why the zombies have been wandering around as if they are alive. The unfathomable force of #b#t4031218##k ... I need to find it and take them to Shammos.

string.name: desc
string.value: I gathered up the #b#t4031218##k and gave them back to Shammos.

string.name: desc
string.value: I helped Scadur make the finest fur coat available in Ossyria.

string.value: Mason the Collector

string.name: req
string.value: Level 60

string.name: desc
string.value: The bird with an odd way of talking, Mason the Collector is always busy looking for something to collect. It especially has a fondness for sparkling objects, and apparently found the Aurora Marble at the Warped Path of Time. Hmmm... wonder who has that item?

string.name: desc
string.value: At the Warped Path of Time, I took out the Lazy Buffys, collected the Aurora Marble, and handed it to Mason.

string.name: desc
string.value: Mason the Collector took a look at the Aurora Marble, and wondered... how it would it look like in an original state of form... It looks like Buffy's marble have been shaped in such way through an outside force... I need to collect #b10 Aurora Marbles#k and #b50 of Buffy's Marbles#k and return to Mason.

string.name: desc
string.value: Just like Mason the collecting fanatic wanted, I managed to gather up more Lazy Buffy marbles and Aurora marbles. In return, I received an item from him that looks quite useful...

string.name: req

string.name: desc

string.name: subject
string.value: Nick, the Son of Scadur the Hunter

string.name: req
string.value: Level 65

string.name: desc
string.value: I met up with Scadur the hunter again through the request of Alcaster. He told me a story of how, a long time ago, a bunch of monsters from the dead mine claimed the life of his wife, enraging his son Nick. 3 years later, he went into the dead mine, hoping to avenge his mother's death, but haven't been heard since. He wants me to find #bNick's Ring#k somewhere at the innermost part of the lava cave. He also wants me to grant his dying wish, which would be collecting #b100 Cerebes' teeth#k. This will be VERY tough to do ...

string.name: desc
string.value: I found what appears to be Nick's #bring#k at the bottom of the scraps of the statue at the innermost part of the lava cave. Seems to have a name engraved on the ring ... maybe Scadur knows what's up.

string.name: desc
string.value: I found Nick's ring at the lava cave, and I also collected a number of Bulldawg's teeth, getting them all to Scadur. Hopefully Nick will be satisfied with this... I got a cape from Scadur that's been passed down from generation to generation ... this ain't bad at all!

string.name: desc

string.name: subject
string.value: Carta the Sea Witch

string.name: req
string.value: Level 90

string.name: desc
string.value: #bMuse#k, who works at the Aquarium Zoo, asked me to go see her. #bMuse#k said she wanted to find out the whereabouts of her boyfriend #bGail#k, who has volunteered to be part of the exploration team that heads deep in the underwater, and asked me if I could go talk to #bCarta#k the sea witch about him.

string.name: desc
string.value: #bCarta#k flat-out claimed she couldn't predict the future, but she said she can at least see what the person in question is doing right now. She also said that since the spell is really difficult to pull off, so I'll need to gather up the items if I want to find out what's in store for Gail. She requested that I get #b3 #t4031256#s#k and #b10 #t4031251#s#k from #r#o8140600##k, and #b1 #t4031253##k that can be obtained through #r#o8510000##k while it's dying.

string.name: desc
string.value: I gathered up all the materials that #bCarta#k asked me get. According to her, something terrible indeed happened to Gail. What can possibly happen underwater? Anyway, I should let #bMuse#k of this immediately. I hope she takes it well...

string.name: desc
string.value: I told #bMuse#k the result of #bCarta#k's fortune-telling. What does it mean by the dark fog that surrounds Gail? Muse was trying to act calm, but I could tell she's feeling nervous about Gail. Is Carta's stuff really worth believing?

string.name: subject
string.value: The Blocked Path of the Ocean

string.name: req
string.value: Level 90

string.name: desc
string.value: I met #bTaeng the Explorer#k in between The Grave of a Wrecked Ship at an empty ship that's been wrecked. He said he's been looking for the traces of his missing men. He came down here to check out the irregular activities that have been taking place here, and one day he lost contact with his men. Not only did he lose them, but he said the path to the bottom of the ocean is blocked too, so he asked me for help on looking for traces of his men. I should wander around looking for #bitems that can be used as evidence#k. If the items the men have used are still here, then maybe the #bsharks#k that have been roaming around #bThe Grave of a Wrecked Ship#k is the one to blame? I should find a #bflashlight#k, a #bcamera#k and a #bnotebook#k, and give them back to #bTaeng the Explorer#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: Taeng the Explorer, whom I've met at The Grave of a Wrecked Ship, asked me to find traces of his men that have disappeared. I was able to gather up the flashlight, the camera, and the notebook that his men used at the time of the attack. Unfortunately, I wasn't able to find any of the missing men.

string.name: subject
string.value: A New Dish for Nanuke

string.name: req
string.value: Level 95

string.name: desc
string.value: Deep in the snow at the Snowy Whale Island, Nanuke wanted to eat something that he'd never eaten before in his life. Apparently, his friend Muse, who lives at Aquarium, offered to make him a tasty new dish, so long as he gathers up the ingredients for her. The problem is... those ingredients are really difficult to gather up. I better go gather up #b150 ink bottles#k and #b80 frozen shark fins#k for Nanuke, so I can deliver them to #bMuse#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: Muse made what seemed like a very tasty dish from the ingredients I got for her. I couldn't see the dish because it was inside a box, but judging from the tasty aroma that filled the room, I knew this was indeed a winner. Muse warned me that this was best eaten when hot, and wanted me to get this to #bNanuke#k before it turned cold. Basically, I have #r1 hour#k to deliver this to #bNanuke#k. Can I do this?

string.name: desc
string.value: I delivered the food that Muse made to Nanuke on time. I had to really run to make it here in 1 hour. Phew, at least seeing Nanuke chow down on the dish made it all worthwhile.

string.value: Destroying the Power of Evil

string.name: req
string.value: Level 105

string.name: desc
string.value: Dark Tachion is an altered version of Tachion, which is the source of power that forms the Time Sphere. It should be deemed dangerous now, and since a creepy, evil force keeps seeping out of it, it must be a dangerous time here. I should destroy this at the lava deep in El Nath.

string.name: desc
string.value: After entering a hidden area where the lava flows, I found a Suspicious Lava. This is where I threw the Dark Tachion to destroy it. The force of evil disappeared along with the Tachion itself.

string.value: Level 50

string.name: desc
string.value: I tried hard going through the 1st level, but had to quit midway through. It's not easy meeting up with the boss … sigh … well, I better go visit Adobis once I get ready for this.

string.name: desc
string.value: I got through the 1st level just fine, and found a #bpiece of fire ore#k. I need another item. Can I get it at the 2nd level?

string.name: req
string.value: Level 50

string.name: desc
string.value: At level 2, I can gather up another material for the item needed to summon up the boss. After going through all the obstacles, apparently the material is at the end, waiting to be picked up … I better hope I don't fall into the lava…

string.name: desc
string.value: I got through the 2nd level just fine, and found an item called #bBreath of Lava#k. So, am I supposed to refine this and the #bpieces of fire ore#k for THE ITEM?

string.name: subject
string.value: Zakum Dungeon, Level III

string.name: req
string.value: Level 50

string.name: desc
string.value: Adobis tells me that if I gather up \n#b30 pieces of zombie's lost gold \ntooth#k, then I can get #bLava's Breath#k and #bpiece of fire ore#k refined. Where can I get them...

string.name: desc
string.value: Adobis tells me that if I gather up \n#b30 pieces of zombie's lost gold \ntooth#k, then I can get #bLava's Breath#k and #bpiece of fire ore#k refined. Where can I get them...

string.name: desc
string.value: I got Adobis the items he needed, and in return, got #bThe Eye of Fire#k, which is the refined product of the combination of #bBreath of Lava#k and the #bpieces of ores of fire#k. So, now that I got this, I should set it on top of the altar, and… the boss … will …?!?!?!

string.name: subject
string.value: Protect Ludibrium

string.name: req
string.value: Level 60

string.name: desc
string.value: I met up with #bMr. Bouffon#k at the Path of Time. I promised him to find a new source of energy that may replace the original Time Sphere, which had been the main source of power for Ludibrium.

string.name: desc
string.value: Thanks to Papulatus Clock with Time Sphere, the monsters below Path of Time have grown much stronger. There is, however, a way to recover the energy from those monsters; defeat them and they'll cough up the item that stores the energy. I'll need to gather up 300 Tachions and 100 Mysterious Powders.

string.name: desc
string.value: I gathered up Tachions and Mysterious Powders as the replacement energy to create the new Time Sphere. I may need to take care of some more business while creating it.

string.name: desc
string.value: To block the cracked dimension that occurred at a vault, something is needed to block it. I should ask Flo at the path of time for help.

string.name: desc
string.value: I found the Piece of Cracked Dimension that Mr. Bouffon was talking about. Apparently, to defeat Papulatus, we need to be at least lvl 80 or higher?

string.name: subject
string.value: A Piece of Crack

string.name: req
string.value: Level 60

string.name: desc
string.value: I met up with Flo who told me about Papulatus. He's a monster that came through a crack in dimension to this world. I will need to get the Piece of Cracked Dimsneion to seal up the cracked dimension. I'll need to eliminate Gigantic Spirit Viking and Grim Phantom Watch who might have entered this world with #bPapulatus Clock#k and collect #bpieces of cracked dimension A, B and C#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: I gathered up 3 types of pieces of cracked dimension and gave it to Flo. I also gave Flo Piece of Cracked Dimension, which has something to do with Papulatus.

string.name: subject
string.value: Eliminate Papulatus

string.name: req
string.value: Level 80

string.name: desc
string.value: Everything is ready. Now all we need to do is eliminate the evil force that is Papulatus Clock. Enter the power-generating room by finding the #bLudibrium Medal#k by defeating the monsters guarding the gate. I also need to place #bPiece of Cracked Dimension#k at the crack to call Papulatus Clock out.\n\n Eliminate Papulatus : #r#a71000001##k

string.name: desc
string.value: Finally got to eliminate Papulatus Clock, the evil force-dripping monster that was hogging the Time Sphere and stealing out all kinds of power through Ludarium! Now to return to Mr. Bouffon.\n\n Eliminate Papulatus : #b#a71000001##k

string.name: desc
string.value: Finally got to eliminate Papulatus Clock, the evil force-dripping monster that was hogging the Time Sphere and stealing out all kinds of power through Ludarium! The Clocktower shall emit forces of nature, and Ludibrium shall be brought in peace.

string.value: The Lost Piece of Crack

string.value: I told #rMr. Bouffon#k that I lost the piece of cracked dimension. He told me he was going to give me another chance and that I should go see #rFlo#k immediately.

string.name: desc
string.value: I was able to regain the lost piece of dimension from Flo. I should seriously take care of Papulatus this time.

string.name: desc
string.value: I was able to regain the lost Ludibrium Medal from Flo. I should seriously take care of Papulatus this time.

string.value: The Lost Piece of Crack

string.name: desc
string.value: I lost the Piece of Cracked Dimension that's been given to me by Flo. After telling #bMr. Bouffon#k of the situation, he wanted me to talk to Flo again. I'm afraid #bFlo#k may be less than pleased by the fact that I lost a very valuable #bPiece of Cracked Dimension#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: After telling Mr. Bouffon that I lost Piece of Cracked Dimension, he wanted me to go see Flo again and talk to him. Flo was pretty upset that I lost the valuable Piece of Cracked Dimension, but then wanted me to really make sure not to ever lose it again, while giving me the #rlast remaining Piece of Cracked Dimension#k that he kept to himself. He warned me that this is the last one, and that if I ever lose it again, #rI won't be able to get it back ever again.#k. I better make sure not to lose it, and give it to Mr. Bouffon.

string.name: subject
string.value: Cody and the Theme Park

string.name: req
string.value: Level 20

string.name: desc
string.value: I ran into a programmer from Wizet while walking around Henesys! His name is Cody, and he seemed to be looking for some help. It looks like I ran out of time to help him, though. On the bright side, it sounds like the Global Theme Park is well on its way!

string.name: desc
string.value: I got Cody all the items he was asking for: #b100 tree branches, 50 pieces of wild boar's tooth, 1 steel plate, and 1000 mesos#k. It wasn't terribly difficult to do. He gave me a Maple Flag as a sign of appreciation … Hmmm, this looks pretty cool. Anyway, now that I got him the stuff, the theme park better get here soon!

string.name: subject
string.value: Halloween with Ria

string.name: desc
string.value: I was told to gather up 250 candies, but I couldn't get them all to her on time. Shucks, if only I could find out what she was going to get me as a reward …

string.name: desc
string.value: I got Ria all the candies she asked for, and she got me a nice Halloween pumpkin basket. It looks pretty cool to carry around. I'll start filling these up with chocolates and candies…

string.name: subject
string.value: Thanksgiving with Maple Administrator

string.name: desc
string.value: The Maple Administrator in Henesys challenged me to gather up all the letters that make up the word #bMAPLESTORY#k, available through monsters. I only had til December 5th to complete this, unfortunately I wasn't able to finish in time.

string.name: desc
string.value: I took on the challenge and got all the letters that consist the word MapleStory to the Maple Administrator in Henesys. Now I need to just wait until the winners are announced. I hope I can get it...

string.name: subject
string.value: Easter : Easter Basket

string.name: req
string.value: Level 8

string.name: desc
string.value: The Maple Administrator needed\n#b100 Tree Branches#k, #b100 Squishy Liquids#k, and #b1 Pig's ribbon#k to make me an #rEaster Basket#k. I wasn't able to get them to her before the end of the Easter event, so I should check back again next year.

string.name: desc
string.value: I got the Easter Basket from the Maple Administrator. Mad Bunny may need this for something... I should go see him now.

string.name: subject
string.value: Cody's Barbecue Party

string.name: desc
string.value: Cody was throwing a#r Barbecue party for Independence Day#k and needed #b50 Pigs' Heads, 50 Tree Branches and 50 Leathers#k to prepare for the Barbecue. Unfortunately I wasn't able to get these to him in time. I'll check back again next year!

string.name: desc
string.value: I gave #bCody#k the materials needed for the Barbecue! I got some#b delicious Barbecue#k and an#b Independence Day Hat#k for a reward!

string.name: subject
string.value: Independence Day : Alien Invasion

string.name: desc
string.value: #bAgent M#k needed help exterminating the #rPlatians#k in Roswell Plains but unfortunately I couldn't complete the mission in time. Maybe next year I can help him out again...

string.name: desc
string.value: After I gave Agent Marco all #b100 Platian Helmets#k, I received the#b Stars and Stripes#k. This flag represents my support for the independence of our World.

string.name: subject
string.value: Cody's Early Halloween

string.name: req
string.value: Level 8

string.name: desc
string.value: I talked to Cody in Henesys, and agreed to help him find #bfifteen snail shells#k for his halloween costume.

string.name: desc
string.value: Turns out Cody wanted a total of fifty snail shells. I totally thought he said fifteen though. Oh well.

string.name: desc
string.value: I gave Cody the snail shells... Maybe I should ask how his project is going.

string.name: desc
string.value: Cody wants me to get him 100 red snail shells now. He kind of has an attitude about it.

string.name: desc
string.value: I gave Cody the red snail shells... I hope that's everything he needs.

string.name: desc
string.value: Sheesh, now Cody wants me to get him a Pig's ribbon for his snail costume.

string.name: desc
string.value: I gave Cody the Pig's ribbon... all right, that's got to be everything, right?

string.name: desc
string.value: In order to finish up Cody's costume, he wants me to bring him a shell from Bob the Snail in Sleepywood. Oh, and he wants a Hot Dog Supreme from the food truck there. Sigh...

string.name: desc
string.value: Cody scrapped the snail costume idea and wants to go as a ghost now! I guess I'll bring him the 10 Tablecloth from Jr. Wraith he asked for.

string.name: desc
string.value: I gave Cody the tablecloths... He couldn't possibly need anything else, right?

string.name: desc
string.value: For helping with his early Halloween costume, Cody gave me a Snail Headband! Maybe hunting down all those snails wasn't a waste of time.

string.name: desc
string.value: Cody was preparing a big party for the MapleStory staff with food and everything, but he forgot to buy the birthday candles for the cake. The Anniversary has passed though, I hope it went okay...

string.name: desc
string.value: I gave him the #b10 Birthday Candles#k he requested. He seemed very much relieved by the fact that the party won't be ruined after all. He gave me a #rMaple Flag#k as a reward. Wow, I haven't seen these in a while!

string.name: subject
string.value: Nanuke and the Chair

string.name: desc
string.value: Nanuke and his huskies greeted me with open arms. He proceeded to give me a resting chair as a way of celebrating MG2's birthday. Anyway, I should sit on this chair and relax for a bit...

string.value: Thanksgiving : Turkey Yellow Egg hunt

string.name: req
string.value: Level 15

string.name: desc
string.value: I'm on a mission to find as many #bYellow Turkey eggs#k as I can for Cody, who has a strange liking for Turkey Egg omelets. I'm going to find as many as I can and bring them back to Cody for prizes! I've heard tamed turkeys can be found around Victoria Island.

string.name: desc
string.value: I found a Yellow Egg for Cody. Maybe I should try and find some more before Thanksgiving is over!

string.name: req
string.value: Level 30

string.name: desc
string.value: I found a Green Egg for Cody. Maybe I should try and find some more before Thanksgiving is over!

string.name: subject
string.value: Thanksgiving : Pumpkin Pie

string.name: req
string.value: Level 15

string.name: desc
string.value: I spoke with that kind old woman, Grandma Benson, and she needs some help with baking the pies. I've agreed to gather #b1 pie crust#k, #b1 pumpkin#k, #bflour#k and #bpowder sugar#k for her, maybe she'll give me a pie to take with me...I hope so!

string.name: desc
string.value: I finished gathering the ingredients for Grandma Benson, and she can finally bake the pies. I received a taste in return, and in something that can help me during a tough battle.

string.name: subject
string.value: Festival of Lights

string.name: req
string.value: Level 23

string.name: desc
string.value: I spoke with Hannah, and she's preparing a Festival of Lights. I've agreed to help her build the Altar by gathering 25 Altar Pieces. She mentioned that the monsters would already have an axe stuck in them, so I should hunt those.

string.name: desc
string.value: Upon my return, Hannah was joyous, having finished the Altar. She now needs candles to signal the start of the ceremony. I'll have to get 9 candles (she mentioned Horned Mushrooms) and bring them back so the Festival of Lights can begin.

string.name: desc
string.value: I acquired the nine candles and gave them to Hannah. The Festival of Lights has begun!

string.name: subject
string.value: Graham Cracked

string.name: desc
string.value: I spoke with the old man, Mr. Kit Kat, and he wants to build a Graham Cracker house, but the monsters keep eating them…not that I blame them, they look delicious... despite my hunger, I've agreed to get 50 Graham Crackers for him so he can build his dream house.

string.name: desc
string.value: I got all the Graham Cracker pieces (and resisted the temptation to eat them), returned to Mr. Kit Kat and he gave me something tasty? Banana Graham Pie. 2 of them!

string.name: desc

string.name: subject
string.value: The Season of Giving

string.name: desc
string.value: I met up with Cody in Henesys and he told me about a party he's throwing at his house. The only problem is he doesn't have any decorations! I'll need to find #ba Christmas Wreath#k, #ba Menorah#k, #ba Christmas Tree Star#k and #ba Pie#k. Cody suggested I try talking to people in Happyville and Shalom Temple.

string.name: desc
string.value: I was able to gather everything Cody asked me to find! For helping it out his present to me was a minature christmas tree. Wouldn't this have counted as a decoration? Well, I hope his party turns out alright.

string.name: subject
string.value: Valentine's Day : Heart Chocolate

string.name: req
string.value: Level 8

string.name: desc
string.value: #bAce of Hearts#k said he can make a nice package for a chocolate with a heart-shaped box, laden with a special spell full of love, as long as I gather up the materials for both the chocolate and the package. Dark Chocolate and White Chocolate can be acquired through monsters, while Heart Box and Gold Ribbon can be acquired through #bCoco#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: Ace of Hearts helped me make a Heart Chocolate laden with a spell full of love. \n\n"The power of love shall protect you..."

string.name: subject
string.value: Valentine's Day : Chocolate Basket

string.name: req
string.value: Level 8

string.name: desc
string.value: [Ace of Hearts] said with Heart Chocolate and additional materials, he can make a #bChocolate Basket#k that expires at a later date. Apparently, it's good for #r5 days#k, longer than that of Heart Chocolate. I can find the Dark Chocolate and White Chocolate from monsters, the Heart Chocolate can be made by Ace of Hearts and the Basket and Cover Materials can be purchased from #bCoco#k.

string.name: desc
string.value: I was able to make a chocolate basket for the person I dearly love for the Valentine's Day through [Ace of Hearts].

string.name: subject
string.value: Cody's Potion

string.name: req
string.value: Level 8

string.name: desc
string.value: I ran into Cody again in Henesys. He's been wondering where potions come from and what they're made of so I agreed to help him on his quest to create his very own potion! I'll need to find #b10 jars#k to store the potion in. Maybe I should look around Henesys Hunting Ground...

string.name: desc
string.value: The first ingredient needed for the Cody Potion is #b10 Hotdog Supremes#k. Hmm... that wouldn't be my first choice but let's see what Cody plans to do.

string.name: desc
string.value: Cody plans to use the juice from #b30 lemons#k as the liquid component in his potion. I can purchase those from the general shop.

string.name: desc
string.value: At last the Cody Potion is complete... but there's something about it... alarm bells are going off in my head. Well, maybe one sip couldn't hurt.

string.name: desc
string.value: The taste is indescribable and after drinking this potion I don't think I'll ever be the same. It sounds like Cody has something else up his sleeve. I'm reluctant to find out but I shouldn't leave him hanging.

string.name: desc
string.value: For enduring one of my toughest challenges yet, Cody gave me the rag he used to clean up the mess he made. It's surprisingly fashionable.

string.value: Level 10
